title: Change review kit fixture: case12_change_review_kit_smoke
why: Demonstrate a deterministic, names-only change review workflow: intent + acceptance + risk/rollback + fixture map, rendered into receipts a reviewer can verify byte-for-byte.

in_scope: Add a new casefile kit under fixtures/input/case12_change_review_kit_smoke/kit/
out_of_scope: No behavioral changes to pfcasefiles runtime
No new fixture naming scheme (case name is locked by Book 4 fixture naming lock)

review_questions: Do the names-only review paths cover the full decision surface for this change?
Are acceptance criteria measurable and verifiable with the proof gate?

notes.determinism: All outputs are ordered, sha256-witnessed, and LF-only text.
notes.review_style: Names-only: start at kit_index.json + manifest.sha256, then inspect only listed artifacts.
